THIS MEANS SHORTER WAVELENGTHS (BLUE) ARE SCATTERED MORE THAN LONGER ONES (RED).  

SO, WHEN THE SUN IS HIGH IN THE SKY, THE BLUE LIGHT IS SCATTERED IN ALL DIRECTIONS, MAKING THE SKY APPEAR BLUE TO OBSERVERS ON EARTH.
